title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：pencil　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pencil 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the headmaster ① sharpened the pencil that no student in the school would have recorded, and he said the sharpening was the whole of the year. The ② pencil, meaning the stick itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a pencil, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ pencil in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ pencil at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pencil, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the headmaster said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pencil was the whole of the matter, meaning the mark and not the stick. The ⑥ pencil, meaning the mark and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; pencil, he said, is either something you sharpen or the only word that means both a stick and a mark. He said the mark is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ pencil had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ pencil of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of recording; pencil, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pencil I remember is the stick recorded in the record, which closed in 1968 and is still recorded as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ pencil, my mother said in 1970, is the only stick that improves by being recorded; every pencil, she said, is a mark that has agreed to look like a stick. She said the mark was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 铅笔（指学堂里每一支旁边的那一支）
B. n. 铅笔（指那支铅笔本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：sharpen the pencil 削这一支铅笔
D. n. 铅笔（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 铅笔之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的铅笔之事）
F. n. 铅笔（指学籍册里写到、被记载的那一支）
G. n. 铅笔、笔迹（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 笔迹（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sharpened the pencil that no student in the school would have recorded
The pencil, meaning the stick itself and not the bell
the pencil at the far gate
the pencil was the whole of the matter
the pencil had become a line in a record
The pencil of the whole thing
A pencil, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: sharpen the pencil 意为“削这一支铅笔”，1961 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯记载的一支铅笔做了一遍。
pencil 意为“铅笔”，指那支铅笔本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被记载。
pencil 意为“铅笔”，指学堂里每一支旁边的那一支，每一支旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
pencil 意为“铅笔”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pencil 意为“铅笔、笔迹”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这支笔迹就是那件事的全部。
pencil 意为“笔迹”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那支铅笔，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pencil 意为“铅笔”，指学籍册里写到、被记载的那一支，到 1966 年这一支成了学籍册里的一行。
pencil 意为“铅笔之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的铅笔之事是一处学堂和三个学年的记载。
pencil 意为“铅笔”，我记得的是学籍册里记载过的那一支，1968 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一支。
pencil 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，铅笔是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的铅笔。
